description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old
Applicant must be SC/ST or Woman entrepreneur
Eligible applicant must hold at least 51% ownership and controlling stake
Minimum composite loan amount is ₹10 lakh
Maximum composite loan amount is ₹1 crore
New or existing Micro and Small Enterprises are eligible
Scheme covers Micro and Small Enterprises
Credit facility is generally covered without collateral security
Credit facility is generally covered without third party guarantee
